SF-24
SA - INJECTOR
INSTALLATION
1. INSTALL INJECTORS ANO DELIVERY PIPES
(a} Install the grommet lo each injector.
{b) Apply a light coat of spindle oil or gasoline to new 0-ring
and install them to each injector.
New 0--Ring
(c) Apply a light coat of spindle oil or gasoline on the place
where a delivery pipe touches on 0-ring.
{d) While turning the injector clockwise and counterclock­
wise, push it to the delivery pipes. Install the 4 injectors.
(e) Position the injector connector outward.
EJ.00202
(f) Place the 2 spacers in position on the cylinder head.
(g) Apply a light coat of spindle oil or gasoline on the place
where a cylinder head touches an 0-ring of the injector.
(h) Place the delivery pipe and fuel pipe together with the 4
injectors in position on the cylinder head.
(i) Temporarily install the 2 bolts holding the delivery pipe to
the cylinder head.
U) Temporarily install the bolt holding the fuel pipe to the cyl­
inder head.
(k) Check that the injectors rotate smoothly,
HINT:
If injectors do not rotate smoothly, the probable cause is incor­
rect installation of 0-ring. Replace the 0-rrng.
(I) Position the injector connector connector outward.
